rules.statement: A deed of gift for services to be rendered is revocable unless the circumstances consisting of non-revocability appear most clearly on the face of the deed itself.
rules.supporting_quote: As a general rule, Kandyan deeds of gift are revocable, and before a particular deed is held to be an exception to that rule, it should be shown that the circumstances consisting non-revocability appear most clearly on the face of the deed itself-Bolonga v. Punchi Mahatmaya1[Ramanathan (1883-68) p. 195]
